name: SceneTransform (scene node / render transform)
summary: Per-entity scene node: position/rotation/scale and render flags; the base that almost every other component depends on. Inline-capable (544 B) so map geometry entities carry it in-place.
added_by: dependency of most components (0x03,0x06,0x0c,0x16,0x1d,0x41,0x45,...) and map inline spawns

fields.0x1a8: attached scene-proxy interface ptr (set by 0x06/0x0c/0x45 OnCreate)

server_relevance: Server needs transforms but not this render node; position replicates via movement state (0x12).
evidence: Prometheus Component_1_SceneRendering; OnCreate of 0x06/0x0c/0x45 fetch comp 0x01 via mask bit 1 and write +0x1a8/+0x1b8; creator slot1 FUN_7ff6509e6380 -> ctor FUN_7ff6509e00c0.

name: DataFlow (per-entity data-flow / parameter binding graph)
summary: Per-entity data-flow node container that other components publish values into (e.g. 0x10 FilterBits registers a data-flow node here). Inline-capable (1616 B).
server_relevance: Client-side presentation plumbing; not replicated.
evidence: Prometheus Component_3_DataFlow.h; 0x10 OnCreate (FUN_7ff650cb09a0) and 0x20 OnCreate (FUN_7ff650cac090) look up comp 0x03 via mask bit 3 and register nodes (FUN_7ff6509e8410/84c0, FUN_7ff6509e83a0).

name: SceneProxy_RadiusWeighted (scene-attached emitter/influence proxy, likely ambient sound emitter)
summary: Attaches a proxy interface (secondary vtable 0x158eb68 at +0x18) to the entity's scene node (0x01 +0x1a8) and sets scene flag 0x10000000000000. Its per-frame proxy method scores itself against a per-world list of observers within a radius (distance attenuation via virtual curve, half-float weights), which looks like an ambient sound emitter or similar influence volume.
added_by: unknown (no STU mapping; 0 live instances in game; lobby scene only)
used_by_systems: LobbyBackgroundSceneSystem 0x15c4440 (lobby #0, OnEntityAdded: GUID -> entity id map)
server_relevance: Client presentation only.
evidence: Creator FUN_7ff650a27160 sets vtable 0x158ec60 + secondary 0x158eb68; OnCreate FUN_7ff650a26440 writes scene+0x1a8=this+0x18, flag 0x10000000000000; proxy slot7 FUN_7ff650a26830 iterates world+0xb0 list and compares squared distance to node radius +0x110. Only subscriber is lobby system 0.

name: AudioListener
summary: Marks the entity whose transform is used as the audio listener; attaches a scene proxy (secondary vtable 0x158f870) to scene node 0x01. The game EA has one dedicated entity {0x01,0x0c}; the lobby singleton entity also has one.
used_by_systems: GameSoundSystem 0x15c5120 (listener entity +0x28 has comp 0x0C: FUN_7ff650a3e4d0(comp0x0C, view target))
server_relevance: Client-only audio.
evidence: Live: game entity 0x8000066e components {0x01,0x0c}; creator FUN_7ff650a3e860; OnCreate FUN_7ff650a3e3e0 sets scene+0x1a8, flag 0x20000000 and FUN_7ff6509e5750(scene,8,..). docs/ECS_Systems.md GameSoundSystem tick.

name: FilterBits (team / visibility filter mask)
summary: Replicated filter/team bitmask (team bits 0x40000..0x200000, local 0x100). On create it registers a data-flow node in 0x03 so the scene/physics pick up team masks.
server_relevance: Server must replicate team/filter bits for every player/networked entity.
evidence: Prometheus Component_10_FilterBits; vtable 0x15c6148 slot1 = shared GetMirrorData 0x140cc04b0; read_stu_at(comp+0x18) = type 0xfb184d9c; 24 live instances on replicated 0x4000xxxx entities.

name: CharacterCollisionProxy (physics capsule following movement state)
summary: STU-backed (0x1ab05d0f: m_radius, m_height, m_isTurret, two enum fields, flags). OnCreate builds a physics body for the entity and picks collision filter 0x1099 for turrets vs 0x1081; CollisionProxySyncSystem pushes the movement-state position into that body each update and refreshes the team filter.
server_relevance: Server likely needs equivalent collision proxies for hit/collision of movers (turrets).
evidence: RegisteredSTUTypes STU_1AB05D0F fields 71EF3CA4=m_radius, BFDEB7F1=m_height, 007CC6B1=m_isTurret; OnCreate FUN_7ff650cae430 reads loader component 0x16, chooses filter 0x1081/0x1099; deps 0x01,0x12; docs CollisionProxySyncSystem.

name: LocalAnimComponent (non-mirrored animation)
summary: STU-backed animation component (0xbfa88b12, parent STUEntityComponent, no fields) bound to the model's skeleton; the non-replicated counterpart of STUMirroredAnimComponent 0x1c, analogous to 0x1e STULocalIdleAnimComponent vs 0x11.

fields.0x18: STU type hash of the definition component
fields.0x20: animation resource handle (from model 0x04 STU data)

name: ModelReference / PlayerPawnLink (controller -> hero, aim/camera/movement attach ids)
summary: Mirrored entity-id links from a player controller to the entities it drives: aim entity, camera attach entity, movement attach entity. PlayerPawnLinkSystem watches field changes to maintain reverse links (0x1f).
server_relevance: Critical: server must replicate the controller->hero ids so the client possesses its hero.
evidence: Prometheus Component_20_ModelReference offsets 0x90/0x94/0x98 match mirror STU fields at STU+0x78/0x7c/0x80; slot1 GetMirrorData 0x140cc04b0; OnCreate registers data-flow node in 0x03.

name: PathdataObstacleBounds (nav-mesh invalidation sphere)
summary: Bounding sphere of a dynamic navigation obstacle. When such an entity is added its id goes into the pathdata dirty list; when deleted, its sphere is used to invalidate the affected pathdata tiles.
server_relevance: Only needed if the server runs bots / navigation.
evidence: Live 0x80000096 comp 0x29: +0x20=(-33.99,6.06,58.47,1.0), +0x30=0.971; 307 instances all on breakable map props {1,3,4,29,2d}; docs PathdataRebuildSystem.

name: LocalPlayer (input commands, view angles, prediction state)

server_relevance: Critical: server must ack command frames and send movement corrections consumed here.
evidence: Prometheus Component_2F_LocalPlayer; 1 live instance on controller 0x40000001; docs ECS_Systems (EA+0xb0+0x468 iterations).
